title: UPSC 13/2026 Various Posts Recruitment 2026
summary: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) , has released a Notification for the recruitment of 13/2026 Dental Surgeon, Ayurveda Physician, Homeopathic Physician & Scientist B Posts on its official website. This recruitment is being conducted for 13 vacancies. The UPSC Application Form has started on 14 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 04 December 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSC 13/2026 Various Posts Recruitment 2026 which are given below. ( Advt No : 13/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must possess a recognized Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) degree or an eligible dental qualification under the Dentists Act, 1948. Candidates with foreign dental qualifications must meet the prescribed eligibility conditions, including passing the Screening Test Examination, wherever applicable. They must also be registered with any State Dental Council or Tribunal in India and complete the Compulsory Rotating Internship (CRI) before appointment.
